note: The look of a speeder mechanic's stall at a race crew's hangout (src/systems/world/speeder_stall.gd; layout: content/core/locations/speeder_stall.json). Dorrin's yard colours, so his cousins' stalls read as the same family business: oily steel counter, a rusty top, a striped canvas awning with a string of bulbs, a pegboard rack, a lift pad with hazard edges. Every metal is the favela's painted metal (LookMaterials.painted: panels, rivets, chipped paint, grime), the wood is the market's planks and the awning the market's canvas. 'scrap' are the walls' and roof patches' sheets (the favela's paints, sun-faded), 'neon' the gear sign on the back wall, 'screen' the diagnostic screen and the lift's buttons.
